geometryRepresentation.findings: Only AssemblyInterferenceEngine consumes real B-Rep ShapeHandles from PartDefinitions via OCCT. All CAM and Manufacturing collision engines consume isolated, ad-hoc Triangle3D[] or CollisionObject[] arrays constructed locally within test fixtures or mock generators.

transformRepresentation.findings: Assembly engines consume 4x4 matrix transforms, but CAM collision engines consume raw ToolPose { tcp: Vector3D, toolOrientation: Vector3D } without canonical kinematic tree synchronization.

resultCanonization.findings: Collision reports and clearance incidents exist only in ephemeral memory (React component state or test assertions). No collision result is serialized into the canonical document snapshot or saved to storage.
